title: Bulk EV Staining with CFDA-SE and NAP-5 Purification
author: Aizea Morales Kastresana
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ber9jd96

steps.title: Prepare 10 mM CFDA‑SE stock
steps.instruction: Warm a new vial of solid CFSE‑DA dye to room temperature (≤10 min), then dissolve the solids in 90 µL anhydrous DMSO to obtain a 10 mM solution.

steps.title: Dilute to 200 µM and aliquot
steps.instruction: Add anhydrous DMSO to the 10 mM solution to reach a total volume of 4500 µL, yielding a 200 µM CFDA‑SE solution; aliquot volumes of choice into tubes and store at –20 °C under desiccating conditions to prevent dye hydrolysis.

steps.title: Thaw and dilute to 40 µM
steps.instruction: Warm one 200 µM aliquot in your hand or a 37 °C water bath until just thawed, then dilute with DPBS to a final concentration of 40 µM, pipetting and vortexing to fully mix the DMSO with DPBS.

steps.title: Prepare EV suspension
steps.instruction: Dilute extracellular vesicles in DPBS to a final volume of 50 µL in a 0.5 mL low‑protein‑binding tube.

steps.title: Label EVs with CFDA‑SE
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL of the 40 µM CFDA‑SE solution to the 50 µL EV suspension, vortex briefly, and spin down quickly.

steps.title: Incubate stained EVs
steps.instruction: Cover the tube with foil and float it in a 37 °C water bath for 2 h, inverting and flicking the tube once halfway through the incubation.

steps.title: Equilibrate NAP‑5 column
steps.instruction: Remove the top and bottom caps of the NAP‑5 column, equilibrate the column with ~10 mL DPBS, and keep the column continuously flushed to avoid drying.

steps.title: Mark collection tubes
steps.instruction: Using a pen, mark two Eppendorf LoBind 1.5 mL tubes at the 0.5 mL line on the side of each tube.

steps.title: Load EV mixture onto column
steps.instruction: Immediately after the last drop of buffer elutes from the column, load the entire 100 µL stained EV mixture onto the gel bed and begin collecting eluate in the first marked 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Add DPBS to column reservoir
steps.instruction: Once the EV mixture has been absorbed into the gel, gently fill the column’s top reservoir with ~3 mL DPBS until it reaches the top.

steps.title: Collect fractions
steps.instruction: Collect the first 0.5 mL of eluate in the first 1.5 mL tube (Fractions 1‑2, void DPBS); then continue elution and collect the next 0.5 mL in the second 1.5 mL tube (Fractions 3‑4, eluted EVs).

steps.title: Flush and store column
steps.instruction: Flush the column with ~10 mL DPBS, then load 3 mL filtered 20 % ethanol for storage.

steps.title: Assess need for new dye aliquots
steps.instruction: Determine whether new CFDA‑SE aliquots must be prepared based on remaining stock and experimental requirements.
